title: Pilgrim’s / Walkers Deli & Sausage Co merger inquiry
content: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) is seeking views on the anticipated acquisition by Pilgrim’s Pride Corporation (part of the JBS group) of the sausage, sliced cooked meat, snacking, bacon and pâté business of Samworth Brothers Limited, trading as Walkers Deli & Sausage Co.
